metadata.description: Q9 unlabeled compatibility pair list. This file intentionally contains no expected_compatible labels and must not be used for scorer tuning. Predictions should be locked before labels are revealed from a separate Q9 labels file.
metadata.selection_policy: Forty source-backed material/interface pairs selected across battery, polymer, ceramic, metal, semiconductor, glass, and cross-domain compatibility surfaces. Exact Q8 pair identities were avoided. Materials are common engineering or product-relevant systems rather than Q8-specific patches.
metadata.holdout_policy: Freeze this pair list before scoring. Run model predictions against this unlabeled file and save locked predictions. Only then merge labels from a separate hidden labels file for metric computation. Q8 remains a spent diagnostic set and must not be reported as a new blind result.
metadata.label_note: Labels assigned by Claude from materials-science first principles BEFORE running the system; a few (9910,9916,9922,9929) are acknowledged borderline.
